period: 2022-07-01 through 2023-12-22; all exits no later than 2023-12-29

policy.score: Equal-weight arithmetic mean of close_location and gap_reclaim_fraction; no fitted weights.
policy.daily_threshold: Within each XTKS date's complete frozen candidate pool, select every score >= the linear empirical 80% quantile. Include all ties; no Top-N cap.
policy.cooldown: One immediately prior official XTKS session per selected symbol; only actually selected rows update cooldown state.
policy.empty_day: Abstain; do not substitute another signal or lower the threshold.

current_system_benchmark_context.reason: Current Bot statistics use TradingView BOTTOM events and a different signal/entry timestamp; this study uses all-TSE daily events and next-session-open entry.

complexity: Low: four fixed setup gates, equal-weight two-feature score, one daily cross-sectional quantile, and one-session symbol cooldown.
